comments.author: Alrn
comments.body: It seems now this will be the reward for getting 8 astronomical objects until 5 September. I wonder what is this item worth or for.. the words seem tell that this is shipbuilding related items.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Being that this is related to Atlantis, allow me. The item effect seems to be this: "When used before fighting the ancient Ganador, once more you will be able to get more "weathered parts" from ancient Ganador."

Source: www.gamecity.ne.jp/dol/gran_atlas/campaign/barca_solar/

So it apparently raises the drop rate of weathered items from Ancient Ganadors (if you're able to find and beat them, that is). Hope that helps. Excuse any errors on my part; I do the best I can. Cheers, and happy stargazing to you.
